##CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Championship 2026!

**Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. 

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#66713-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

For information regarding FMC, 4BLD, 5BLD, and MBLD, please refer to the [FMC/BLIND](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#67514-fmc-blind) tab.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026#62666-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips.

---

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) and follow CubingBC on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/p/Cubingbc-61569731858139/) or [Instagram.](https://www.instagram.com/cubingbc/)

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTQxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3ac052458bf99a2d6ce589b161550c7321f8e669/CubingBC%20and%20SpeedcubingCanadaLogo.png)

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Health and Safety:**
Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

Note that the qualifying times currently listed on the [events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026#competition-events) are the **early qualifying times**; these will be updated after January 14 to reflect the final qualifying times.

items.information:

**Berlin ist Mega!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, im schönen Bezirk Charlottenburg, Ortsteil Westend. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you there. You can expect a beautiful venue right next to the city highway in the heart of Berlin, great disciplines, and, above all, generous cutoffs, a motivated organizing team, and much more. 

**Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Sunday March 29th, 2026 at 10 pm (2 weeks before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

**Les inscriptions seront clôturées le dimanche 29 mars 2026 à 22h (2 semaines avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans le cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 45-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 45 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUyNzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--52b589b7024452b0af80173384400764db1a004b/allstars(1).png)
# IMPORTANT

Utah All-Stars 2026 is a unique competition that has been organized in parallel with Utah Newcomers 2026. Both competitions will happen on the same day in the same venue. All-Stars is an exciting opportunity for the best of Utah to compete against each other. If you are an experienced competitor, even if you don't consider yourself to be the best of the best, we ask that you register for this competition. If you are a first time or less experienced competitor (competed for the first time in 2024, 2025, 2026 or otherwise consider yourself to be less experienced), we strongly encourage you to register for Utah Newcomers, as the scheduling of both competitions has been tailored specifically to improve the expereince for you.

The most unique aspect of this competition is how the schedules have been interleaved. For each event, the finals of All-Stars will immediately preceed the first round of the same event of this competition.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [Website](https://utahcubing.org/) to find upcoming Utah Cubing Association competitions! Here you can also find our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server.

The most unique aspect of this competition is how the schedules have been interleaved. ## [FR]

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

**Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 20 février 2026 à 22h.** Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Friday, February 20th, 2026 at 10 pm.** You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

# 9년 만에 열리는 제주 대회!
WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

# The first WCA competition in Jeju since 2017!
If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitorshttps://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67003-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Jeju2026#67002-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___

## Please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69106-favorites-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab before registering.

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request.

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.

Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

🇧🇷 **(Português) Brasileiro:**
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8).


❗️**IMPORTANTE**
Nesta competição estaremos com uma campanha beneficente que visa a ajuda para os mais necessitados. Também teremos premiação para as 3 pessoas que mais doarem durante os dias de campeonato! Assim, além de nos divertimos, contribuímos para a construção de um mundo melhor. Saiba mais na pagina [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente)


💵 **PREMIAÇÃO EM DINHEIRO** 💵
Nesta competição, estaremos realizando a premiação em dinheiro para o pódio da modalidade principal do campeonato, o Clock. Todas as informações estão dispostas na página [Premiação em Dinheiro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro)

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista este [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [regulamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) da WCA antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da primeira modalidade em que vai competir.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Iniciante (primeira competição)', e "Feminino" que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.


🇬🇧 **English:**
Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any problem registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA&t).


❗️❗️**IMPORTANT**
This competition will feature a charity campaign to help those most in need. We'll also have prizes for the three people who donate the most during the competition! This way, we'll not only have fun, but we'll also contribute to building a better world. Learn more on the [Charity Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64648-campanha-beneficente) page.


💵 **CASH PRIZES** 💵
In this competition, we will be awarding cash prizes for the podium finishers in the main event, Clock. All information is available on the [Cash Prizes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuritibaContraoTempo2026#64649-premiacao-em-dinheiro) page.


If this is your first time competing, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) to learn how to compete. Please read the WCA [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the first event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Beginner (first competition)', and "female" which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

# **¡Halcones Tehuacán 2026!**
**Español**
¡Tehuacán vuelve a alzar el vuelo!
Tras 8 años, y de la mano de la **Preparatoria Federal por Cooperación Gilberto Martínez Gutiérrez**, el desafío del Cubo Rubik regresa a la cuna del maíz, donde la velocidad, estrategia y visión de halcón se ponen a prueba.

items.information:
## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## Sponsorship

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png)

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.

The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard.
Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information.

## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## NOTICE OF FILMING
Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information:
(SRB)

Battle for Belgrade 2026 je dvadeset i deveto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. 

**Ovo takmičenje će se razlikovati od uobičajenih takmičenja koja smo do sada organizovali. Takmičari će biti podeljeni u 2 tima i zajedno će pokušati da ostvare što veći broj poena da bi osvojili nagrade. Pročitajte detaljnije o konceptu takmičenja** [ovde.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleforBelgrade2026#68110-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)

------------------------

(ENG)

Battle for Belgrade 2026 is the 29th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. 

**This competition will be different from the ones we are usually organizing. Competitors will be divided into 2 teams, and will work together to try and achieve as many points as possible. Read more about the competition's concept** [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BattleforBelgrade2026#68110-battle-for-belgrade-koncept-battle-for-belgrade-concept)

##### Español
​
**¡Bienvenidos a Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!**
​
San Andrés Cholula se convierte en el campo de batalla de la velocidad,
donde **no compites contra otros… compites contra el tiempo**.
Cada décima decide, cada centésima define.

3 rondas de las categorías más rápidas.
El reto más grande: **vencer al reloj**.
​
Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **Municipo de San Andrés Cholula** y a la **Presidenta Municipal Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**.
​
 Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).
​
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla y el equipo organizador con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen.

##### English
​
**¡Welcome to Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026!**
​
San Andrés Cholula becomes the battlefield of speed,
where **you don’t compete against others… you compete against time**.
Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines.

3 rounds of the fastest events.
The greatest challenge: **beat the clock**.
​
This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **Municipality of San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**.
​
 Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**

By attending, you authorize the use of your image.

##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Winter 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Winter 2026 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information:
Arizona's first quiet championship!  This is competition will only have quiet events, and will not have the regular 3x3 event.  Since this is a quiet competition, spectators and competitors are expected to be quiet and minimize noise during events.

### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each.  This is due to venue space and limited seating available.

### Arizona's state championship will be held right before this competition (Jan 17-18), in Tempe, and will have all other events.  Online registration closes 1/10/26 at 5 PM MST.
Register [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArizonaChampionship2026) for Arizona Championship.

### 🇧🇷 Português
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$35. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$35. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: Porten til Ishavet 2026
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Tromsø og Nord-Norge for første gang på 8 år! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese  [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortentilIshavet2026#26554-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Tromsø and Northern Norway for the first time in 8 years! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

### New Competitors
There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PortentilIshavet2026#26554-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

**¡Nos vemos en Tomé!**

---

The sixth edition of the **'CubiKonce'** competition is taking place in Concepción, this time named **'CubiTomé 2026.'**

✨ **We eagerly await your participation in this competition.**  
🍀 **Good luck, cube enthusiast friends!**
​

​
**See you in Tomé!**

items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

[EN]

### OCDSB Students!

OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: " "OCDSB Student, my student email is: **{_}@OCDSB"**" Please do not pay the registration fee.

### Ottawa Winter Series

This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026 (Friday Afternoon) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Registration Reminders

If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.


---

[FR]

### Les élèves de l'OCDSB!

Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {_____@OCDSB}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription.

### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026 (Vendredi Apres-midi) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter A 2026
items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

[EN]

### OCDSB Students!

OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is: **{_}@OCDSB"**" Please do not pay the registration fee.

### Ottawa Winter Series

This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter B 2026 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Registration Reminders

If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.


---

[FR]

### Les élèves de l'OCDSB!

Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon numéro d'étudiant est {numéro d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription.

### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter B 2026 (samedi matin) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Winter C 2026 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc).

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc).

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information:

Drodzy,
ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na pierwszą imprezę nowego roku pod szyldem Cube Factory!

Wracamy do szalonej konwencji, podnosimy limity i dajemy Wam spokojnie zdobyć oficjalne średnie w mniej popularnych konkurencjach!

Zapraszamy!

**WAŻNE**
Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2 regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia.

Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 28

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
Dear All,
Cube Factory Team invites you to the first Cube Factory competition of the New Year!

We're back to the crazy high cut-offs and limits so that you can achieve your dreamt-of average in some less popular events!

See you there!

**IMPORTANT**

Due to the high cumulative limit for the 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded events, experienced competitors may begin their attempts later in the round. In such a case, pursuant to point 2u2 of the WCA regulations, the competitor's cumulative limit will be reduced by the time relative to how much they were late

3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 28.
